title: Ezekiel 36:24-27 — clean water, a new heart, walk in My statutes
summary: Ezekiel 36:24-27 in English: God will gather Israel from the nations, sprinkle clean water on them to cleanse them, give a new heart and spirit, and put His Spirit within them to walk in His statutes. Below, chuk (חק) 'Statute' is shown in blue, matching the word statutes in verse 27.

text.text: 24 For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and I will bring you back into your own land.
25 I will also sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your impurities and all your idols.
26 I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
27 And I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes and to carefully observe My ordinances.

keywords: I will put my Spirit within you
